## Example 6.2 {#iv6-example-6-2 .vector-lesson .magnitude-lesson .angles-lesson }

```{=html}
<p>Find the angle, in degrees, between the vectors <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{a}=-2\underset{\sim}{i}-\underset{\sim}{j}-\underset{\sim}{k}"></span> and <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{b}=\underset{\sim}{i}+2\underset{\sim}{j}-\underset{\sim}{k}"></span>.</p><div data-module="reveal-panel" class="a-reveal"><button class="toggle-panel" aria-pressed="false">Show solution</button><div class="panel-answer" hidden><div class="a-eq"><span data-math="\underset{\sim}{a}\cdot\underset{\sim}{b}=(-2)(1)+(-1)(2)+(-1)(-1)=-3"></span></div><div class="a-eq"><span data-math="|\underset{\sim}{a}|=\sqrt{(-2)^2+(-1)^2+(-1)^2}=\sqrt6"></span></div><div class="a-eq"><span data-math="|\underset{\sim}{b}|=\sqrt{1^2+2^2+(-1)^2}=\sqrt6"></span></div><div class="a-eq"><span data-math="\cos\theta=\frac{-3}{\sqrt6\sqrt6}=-\frac12\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\theta=120^\circ"></span></div></div></div>
```

<div class="booklet-cue">Booklet Section 6 · p. 42</div>

::: notes
The same method applies in 3D; add the third product and include the third squared component. No spatial applet is needed.
:::
